title: Speaking Practice 17 - Describe a Celebration You Enjoyed
description: IELTS Speaking Part 2: Describe a celebration or festival you enjoyed.

stimuli.title: Part 2: Describe a Celebration You Enjoyed
stimuli.content:
You will have 1 minute to prepare and then speak for 1-2 minutes.

Describe a celebration or festival you enjoyed.

You should say: what the celebration was, where and when it took place, who you were with, and explain why you enjoyed it.

questionGroups.instruction: Speak for 1-2 minutes using the prompts.

questions.content: Describe a celebration or festival you enjoyed.

explanation.sampleAnswer: The most memorable celebration I attended was Tet, the Vietnamese Lunar New Year, at my grandparents house last year. The whole extended family gathered, we prepared traditional dishes like banh chung, decorated the house with apricot blossoms, and exchanged lucky money. The warmth and togetherness made it truly special.

questions.content: How are celebrations different now compared to the past?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Celebrations have become more commercialized. People spend more on gifts and decorations but sometimes lose the traditional meaningful activities.

questions.content: Do you think public holidays are important?

explanation.sampleAnswer: Yes, they give people time to rest, spend with family, and preserve cultural traditions that might otherwise be forgotten.
